source_semantics.review: Individually review all seven complete files and eleven hunks of the dialog heading change. Four external example templates, one inline demo and CDK/Material test templates change h1 to h2; focus-query expectations change h1[tabindex=-1] to h2[tabindex=-1]. A finite heading-tag and exact focus-query literal projection proves every other complete TS/HTML operation remains unchanged. All182 source cases retain identity;179 complete callbacks are unchanged and three change heading/query/template literals. Heading levels and default typography can differ, so neither accessibility, rendering, focus delivery nor style equivalence is claimed. The owned historical legacy dialog still uses its h1 first-heading regression and Material16 templates/classes/styles. User authorization requires no consumer structure/CSS/SCSS changes; this modern example/fixture preference does not justify rewriting owned or Cyph headings, source goldens or focus expectations. Preserve the actual historical contract and validate its real native focus/lifecycle path through the separate artifact/floor gates.
